context: Fix in the product at the stringification boundary in _match_snowflake_stage so the predicate and get_cloud_path_info cannot drift: normalize backslashes to forward slashes when the input was a Path (a stage reference is a Snowflake URI grammar, not a local filesystem path, so a Path-typed one should be interpreted with '/' separators). Keep rejecting non-str/non-Path input. Add coverage using PureWindowsPath so the regression reproduces on Linux CI rather than only in the Windows nightly.
description: Genuine PRODUCT cross-platform defect, not a test artifact. benchbox/utils/cloud_storage.py:425 is_snowflake_stage_path accepts Union[str, Path] in its signature, but _match_snowflake_stage stringifies the Path and matches _SNOWFLAKE_STAGE_RE, which requires '/' after the stage token. On Windows str(WindowsPath('@~/benchbox')) == '@~\\benchbox', so the regex never matches and the predicate returns False for a valid Snowflake user-stage reference. Confirmed mechanically: PureWindowsPath('@~/benchbox') -> '@~\\benchbox' vs PurePosixPath -> '@~/benchbox'. Surfaced by tests/unit/utils/test_cloud_storage_snowflake_stage.py::TestIsSnowflakeStagePath::test_accepts_path_objects_and_rejects_non_string_input in Nightly run 30473819253. The test is asserting correct behavior - fix the product, not the test.

preserves.behavior: abfss://container@account... URIs must still never be misrouted to the stage matcher; str inputs behave exactly as today

verifications.command: uv run -- python -c "from pathlib import PureWindowsPath; from benchbox.utils.cloud_storage import is_snowflake_stage_path; assert is_snowflake_stage_path(PureWindowsPath('@~/benchbox'))"
verifications.description: a Windows-style Path stage reference is recognized
